verdict.rationale: Floot says it uses a credit system where you can top up credits without changing plans [floot-docs-8]. It also states that MCP-driven building runs on your Claude or ChatGPT subscription rather than Floot credits [floot-docs-16, floot-docs-29], which clarifies one cost path. Database SQL dumps are said to be available on any plan [floot-docs-24]. Missing for 10: a per-action credit or token consumption breakdown, a documented list of what each plan includes, pricing tiers and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
